cases.name: Units and reservations
cases.prompt: I have 10 m of red ribbon, 2 m reserved for cards. A new wreath needs 9 m. It comes in 5 m rolls.
expectations: Calculates 8 m available after the reservation.
Identifies a 1 m shortage for the wreath.
Quotes one 5 m roll if whole-roll purchasing is desired.

cases.name: Reusable equipment
cases.prompt: For the school project we used 3 of 12 felt sheets and borrowed the hot-glue gun from shelf B.
expectations: Records the 3-sheet usage against the project.
Tracks the glue gun as borrowed or moved.
Avoids decrementing the gun as a consumed unit.

cases.name: Unreconciled quantity
cases.prompt: My log says 2 jars of glitter. Today I used 250 grams. I don't know the jar weight.
expectations: Retains jars and grams in their original units.
Does not subtract 250 from 2 or invent a conversion.
Logs the usage as pending a unit conversion or count.
Asks for jar weight or measured remaining stock.
